title: Zoom: Breakout Rooms, Chat, and Scaling
description: Add breakout rooms, in-meeting chat, and architecture for 1000+ participant meetings.

data.text: Add breakout rooms for small group sessions, in-meeting text chat, and discuss architecture for large-scale meetings with thousands of participants.

data.title: BreakoutRoom and InMeetingChat
Scaling video
data.text: For 1000+ participants, use SFU (Selective Forwarding Unit) architecture. The SFU receives each participant's stream and forwards only relevant streams. This reduces upload bandwidth from O(N^2) to O(N).

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: BreakoutRoom is a sub-meeting with its own participant list
InMeetingChat supports broadcast, room, and direct messages
Media routing is selective, not broadcast
data.takeaway: Zoom is a meeting with rooms and chat. Breakout rooms are nested meetings. Chat is message routing. SFU scales the media layer.
